# ci-pipelines review: all workflows

**Result: 0 critical, 5 required, 0 suggestions.**

Intake: pnpm with pnpm-lock.yaml (detected); one published package, `engines` `>=22` (detected); Node majors 22, 24 and 26 (default: offline list tools.md dated 2026-11-09); private repo, 2 vCPU (default); required checks and run history unknown. Defaults: Node support list from the offline list, visibility private.

Required checks: unreadable (no GitHub remote). Every current job name may be required.

Tools:
- actionlint: on PATH (1.7.7)
- zizmor: not on PATH. Install it with `uvx zizmor` or `brew install zizmor`.

## Required

| # | Rule | Where | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SEC-03 | .github/workflows/ci.yml:9 | The workflow has no top-level `permissions` block. | Add `permissions: contents: read` at the top level, before `jobs:`. |
| 2 | SEC-05 | .github/workflows/ci.yml:53 | The checkout of the `typecheck` job keeps its credentials. | Add `with: persist-credentials: false` to that checkout. |
| 3 | COST-04 | .github/workflows/ci.yml:32 | The `lint` job has no `timeout-minutes`. | Set `timeout-minutes: 10` on the `lint` job. |
| 4 | COST-07 | .github/workflows/ci.yml:87 | The `build` job runs on the floating label `ubuntu-latest`. | Replace it with `ubuntu-24.04`. |
| 5 | COST-08 | .github/workflows/ci.yml:75 | The checkout of the `test` job uses `fetch-depth: 0` and no step reads the history. | Remove `fetch-depth: 0` from that checkout. |

## Job graph after the fixes

```
changes ─┬─ audit ──┐
lint ────┤          │
typecheck┤          ├─ ci-passed
test ────┤          │
build ───┴──────────┘
```

## Approve

Reply with the findings to fix: `all`, `none`, a list such as `1,3,5`, or a range such as `1-12`.
